components.name: Point control
components.description: Preview of the native 48dp control. Pressed opacity is 0.55.
components.html: <button class="ds-point" aria-label="Add point"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="8" y="8" width="32" height="32" rx="11" fill="none" stroke="#686C67" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M24 16v16M16 24h16" fill="none" stroke="#F3F5F0" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-point { display: block; width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: #000000; } .ds-point:active { opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Undo control
components.description: Preview of enabled undo after score refresh. Disabled opacity is 0.3.
components.html: <button class="ds-undo" aria-label="Undo last point"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14 18a12 12 0 1 1 4 17M24 29l-6 6 6 6" fill="none" stroke="#F3F5F0" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-undo { display: block; width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: #000000; } .ds-undo svg { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-undo:active svg { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-undo:disabled svg { opacity: 0.3; }

narrative.overview: Large, lightweight point scores lead a single black watch screen. Outlined plus buttons sit beside the scores; the games row and undo control have less visual emphasis. The spacing follows the round display of the Samsung Galaxy Watch 5 Pro.
dos: Do preserve the two plus controls and the large point scores as the scoring screen's main row.
Do retain native text fitting and fixed touch targets when adjusting proportions.
Do keep secondary scoring and undo visually quieter than the points.
donts: Don't add names, menus, banners, extra controls, or a completion screen to this scoring view.
Don't draw a hardware bezel inside the app.
